select A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID as TRADE_ID, /*交易编号*/ null as FPROD_ID, /*父产品代码*/ C.FINPROD_MARKET_ID PROD_ID, /*产品代码*/ (case A.PS when 'C10' then '05' else '04' end) as TRADE_TYPE, /*交易方向*/ A.TRADE_DATE as REG_DATE, /*计息结束日*/ A.TRADE_DATE as SETTDATE_DATE, /*确认日期*/ A.SETTLE_DATE as PAY_DATE, /*现金流发生日期*/ (case A.PS when 'C10' then A.SHARE_AMT else 0 end) as TRADE_QTY, /*红利再投份额*/ (case A.PS when 'C10' then A.TRADE_AMT else 0 end) as TRADE_AMT, /*红利再投金额*/ (case A.PS when 'C9' then A.TRADE_AMT else 0 end) as INT_AMT, /*现金分红金额*/ B.TDY_SHARE_AMT REG_TRADE_QTY, /*权益登记日份额*/ (case REVDL.UPDATE_TIME when NULL then 'E' else 'D' end)status, A.REMARK as REMARK, /*备注*/ REVDL.CREATE_TIME REV_DATE /*撤销日*/ from TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL A inner join FIN_PRODUCT C on A.FINPROD_ID = C.FINPROD_ID and C.PROFIT_TYPE = '03' /*货币型产品*/ left join BOK_POSITION_PRD B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.CDATE = DATE_ADD(A.TRADE_DATE,INTERVAL -1 DAY) LEFT JOIN TRD_FIN_PRODUCT_DEAL_TOTAL REVDL ON A.TOTLE_TRADE_ID = REVDL.P_TRADE_ID where C.FINPROD_TYPE2 = 'F16' and A.PS in ('C9', 'C10') and ifnull(A.p_trade_id, 'NOREV') = 'NOREV' AND( ifnull(A.UPDATE_TIME,A.CREATE_TIME) > #{interfDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} or ifnull(C.UPDATE_TIME,C.CREATE_TIME) > #{interfDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} or ifnull(B.UPDATE_TIME,B.CREATE_TIME) > #{interfDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} or ifnull(REVDL.UPDATE_TIME,REVDL.CREATE_TIME) > #{interfDate,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) union all SELECT D.TRADE_ID TRADE_ID, /*交易编号*/ (case B.FINPROD_TYPE2 when 'F24' then prd2.FINPROD_MARKET_ID else '' end) FPROD_ID, /*父产品代码*/ (case B.FINPROD_TYPE2 when 'F24' then B.finprod_id else B.FINPROD_MARKET_ID end) PROD_ID, /*产品代码*/ (case D.PS when 'C10' then '05' else '04' end) as TRADE_TYPE, /*交易方向*/
DATE_ADD(D.TRADE_DATE,INTERVAL -1 DAY) REG_DATE, /*权益登记日*/ D.TRADE_DATE SETTDATE_DATE, /*确认日期*/ D.SETTLE_DATE PAY_DATE, /*现金流发生日期*/ (case D.PS when 'C10' then D.SHARE_AMT else 0 end) as TRADE_QTY, /*红利再投份额*/ (case D.PS when 'C10' then D.TRADE_AMT else 0 end) as TRADE_AMT, /*红利再投金额*/ (case D.PS when 'C9' then D.TRADE_AMT else 0 end) as INT_AMT, /*现金分红金额*/ PRD.TDY_SHARE_AMT REG_TRADE_QTY, /*权益登记日份额*/ (case REVDL.UPDATE_TIME when NULL then 'E' else 'D' end) status, /*有效状态*/ D.REMARK remark, REVDL.CREATE_TIME REV_DATE /*撤销日*/ FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT B ON D.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL D1 ON D.B_TRADE_ID = D1.TRADE_ID /* LEFT JOIN PRD_BONUS_PLAN_N A ON D1.B_TRADE_ID = A.BONUS_PLAN_ID*/ LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL REVDL ON D.TRADE_ID = REVDL.P_TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN BOK_POSITION_PRD PRD ON PRD.FINPROD_ID = D.FINPROD_ID AND PRD.CDATE = DATE_ADD(D.TRADE_DATE,INTERVAL -1 DAY) LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT prd2 on prd2.FINPROD_ID = B.P_FINPROD_ID
mapper.delete: delete from CHB_PRD_BONUS_DEAL where DATE_FORMAT(UPDATE_TIME,'%Y-%m-%d') = DATE_FORMAT(NOW(),'%Y-%m-%d')
